name: Welcome to the Karoshi Club
source:
The story follows Kenji Haishima, a former game developer, as he tries to find a new job and land an interview for the sales specialist position at a new company.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了前游戏开发者Kenji Haishima试图找到一份新工作并获得一家新公司销售专员职位的面试机会。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624950/]Steam[/url]]
